content.Title: Implantable Cardiovascular Defibrillators (ICDs) and Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy (CRT)
content.Section: 7.4.1 Implantable Cardioventer Defibrillators (ICDs) and Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy (CRT)
content.Antiarrythmics: Investigates interactions of antiarrhythmic drug therapy with implantable defibrillators in patients resuscitated from near-fatal ventricular arrhythmias.

Study Highlights.Outcome: Effects on therapy observed in patients.
Evaluation of antiarrhythmic effects with respect to survival.
Impact of antiarrhythmic therapy on patients with myocardial infarction and reduced ejection fraction.

Study Highlights.Population: Patients with high risk for ventricular tachyarrhythmia

genes.context: Genetic risk of atrial fibrillation in patients with dilated cardiomyopathy.
